# Theme brief: RION Solutions

Pages: `/startup-work/rion/`, its sub-projects `nexus-command-center` and `rion-county-api`, and `/web-design/rion-website/`.
Tokens: `/startup-work/rion/brand.css`.

- Colors: black `#000000`, deep navy `#04070D`, `#10131C` and `#0D0D0D`, red `#FF3131` (shapes and glows), button red
  `#C9182A` (white text passes AA on it), links `#FF6B6B`, cool grey `#D5DBE6`, glass cards at 5% white.
  Ignore the purples `#814AC8` and `#DF7AFE` (template leftovers).
- Fonts: Figtree, mostly light weight for big headings. Google Fonts. (Satoshi also appears on the live site; skip it.)
- Logo: `/startup-work/rion/img/logo.webp` (upside-down triangle around a hexagon, red gear, "RION" in white), made
  transparent from the dark logo file.
- Motifs: starfield with a red glow behind the headline, red "New" badge, dark glass product cards, code-style mockups.
  Sleek and tech-forward.
- Motion ideas:
  - Slow drifting starfield with a red glow that follows the cursor.
  - The hexagon and gear in the logo rotate slowly.
  - Product cards (FORGE, ARGUS, NEXUS) glow red on the edge when hovered.
  - Code mockups type themselves out.
- Images: `rion/img/` hero, logo, products, thumb. `rion-website/img/site.webp`. The two sub-project pages use diagrams
  drawn for this site (`img/figure.svg`).
- Company name: "RION Solutions" (the live site says RION Solution or RION AI Solutions).
